inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: An evaluation of the director's annual training completed between 11/03/2024 and 11/03/2025 found that the director had not completed the required annual training on the topic of handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials. The director's date of hire is 11/03/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: Two children were missing current immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on DFPS investigation conducted, parent was not notified of less serious injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Paint was observed chipping and peeling in the school age classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three out of ten children files reviewed do not have complete immunization records.     Note: One child's parents submitted their current record during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on external documentation, operation staff did not notify parent of less serious injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children: Based on external documentation, caregiver was completing daily infant report sheets and did not observe the incident until after injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administrative and clerical duties that take caregiver's attention away from children (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person: Based on external documents received, identity of person who was picking up child was not verified or placed in child's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies for Release of Children - Record Identity of Person (26 TAC §746.4103(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two out of the nine children observed were not strapped in high chairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: During inspection, two children did not have current immunizations on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: During investigation inspection, toilet bowl cleaner was observed on the floor near the toilet that children use. Wheat Thins were observed open next to clorox wipes.    Noted: toilet bowl cleaner was placed in a shelf out of reach and wheat thins were removed and clorox wipes were put into a cabinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using: During investigation inspection, two toys were observed with standing water inside the toys.    Noted: Water was emptied from the toys and flipped over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using (26 TAC §746.3407(6))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: Medication was not kept or stored in the original container for a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: During investigation inspection, infant diaper changing pad had tears.    Noted: Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: During investigation inspection, two baby walkers with wheelers were observed in the infant room.    Noted: Walkers were removed from the classroom. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During investigation inspection, 11 out of the 12 classrooms observed had food, and diapers in trash can without a lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: During investigation inspection, bottle used to feed infant did not have child's name on it.    Noted: Name was added by director.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During investigation inspection, playground was observed with broken play equipment and trash observed on the ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: During follow up inspection, staff hired on 3/24/2022 and 4/25/2022 have not obtained completion of High School diploma or GED equivalent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: During follow up inspection, staff hired on 6/20/2022 did not have proof of pre-service.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors: During follow up inspection, operational policies did not state if operation has unassigned epinephrine auto injectors on site.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Unassigned Epinephrine Auto-Injectors (26 TAC §746.501(a)(29))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: During follow up inpsection, staff hired on 1/18/21 had 16.5 hours of training for the annual year 2021-2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: During follow up inspection, 1 out of the 8 classrooms observed did not have activity plan posted.    Noted: this was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: During follow up inspection, staff hired on 4/25/22, and 3/24/22 have transportation training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: During follow up inspection, operational policies did not discuss the promotion of physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergencies: During follow up inspection, operational policies did not discuss the procedure for medical emergencies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergencies (26 TAC §746.501(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Water Activities: During follow up inspection, operational policies did not state the operation participates in water activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Water Activities (26 TAC §746.501(a)(15))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases: During follow up inpsection, operational policies did not have information for vaccine preventable diseases.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Vaccine Preventable Diseases (26 TAC §746.501(a)(28))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: During follow up inspection, 1 of the 3 playgrounds observed needed mulch.    Noted: Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Field Trips: During follow up inspection, operational policies did not discuss that operation participates in field trips.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Field Trips (26 TAC §746.501(a)(16))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation: During follow up inspection, operational policies did not discuss how parents can come to operation and participate in various activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(21))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing: During monitoring inspection, staff hired on 3/24/2022 and 11/19/19 did not have first aid training on file and had unsupervised contact with children in care.    Staff hired on 3/14/22, 1/18/20, 3/24/22, and 11/19/19 did not have first aid training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors -   Pediatric first aid with rescue breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training: During monitoring inspection, staff hired on 1/18/21, 4/25/22, 1/18/20, and 3/24/22 did not have transportation training on file for 2021-2022 year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation Training (26 TAC §746.1301(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: During monitoring inpsection, staff hired on 1/18/20 had 4 hours of training and staff hired of training for the training annual year 2021-2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: During monitoring inspection, children were observed watching National Geographic. Television program was not related to planned activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: During monitoring inspection, staff hired on 11/19/19 did not have proof of pre-service.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: During monitoring inspection, inspection report dated 9/23/2020 was posted.    Noted: Picture was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: During monitoring inspection, staff hired on 5/5/22 and 2/18/19 did not have identification card on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training: During monitoring inspection, directors did not have 30 hours of annual training for 2021-2022 year. Staff hired on 1/18/21 had 11 hours and staff hired on 2/18/19 had 3 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Directors 30- Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(6)(A))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: During monitoring inpsection, caregiver was observed using their cell phone while children were in care.    Noted: This was observed by director and licensing staff. Caregiver was sent home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: During monitoring inspection, staff hired on 5/5/22, 3/14/22, 3/24/22, 2/18/19, and 4/25/22 did not have high school diploma or education requirements in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: During monitoring inspection, staff with hire dates of 5/5/22, 2/18/19, and 4/25/22 had online CPR training.    Staff hired on 3/14/22, 1/18/20, 3/24/22, and 11/19/19 did not have CPR training on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver: During monitoring inspection 5 out of the 11 classrooms observed were not following written activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans - Plan Followed by Caregiver (26 TAC §746.2203(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection: During monitoring inspection, operation did not have most recent Sanitation Inspection report for inspection that was conducted on November 2021. Operation has report for 2/3/2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3403)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion: Based on external documentation, suspension and expulsion was not documented in operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Suspension and Expulsion (26 TAC §746.501(a)(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: Based on external documentation, caregiver was observed using her phone when incident occured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: I observed a 14 month old infant sleeping in the crib with a bottle. The caregiver removed the bottle from the crib. A photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One infant caregiver was caring for 6  infants ages10 months, 11  months, 13 months, 13 months, 14 months, and 14 months. The specified age group is 13 months. The caregiver was over ratio for infants by caring for 1 more infant than allowed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages: Caregivers was not aware of the children's ages and did not have a sheet with the information available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Children's Names and Ages (26 TAC §746.1203(3))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: I observed 5 infants sitting at the high chair table not strapped in. A photos were taken and the caregivers strapped the children in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation allowed caregiver  contact with children in care and did not have fingerprint result on file or DPS results on file. The caregiver  had direct access to children.  The director asked the caregiver to leave.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Operational Policies - Inform Parents That They May Visit Center Anytime During Operating Hours: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operation is not  allowing parents inside the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operational Policies - Inform Parents That They May Visit Center Anytime During Operating Hours (26 TAC §746.501(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Special Diets - Employees given information: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operation failed to give caregiver the special diet for children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Special Diets - Employees given information (26 TAC §746.3311(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Based on information obtained during the investigation, there is not sufficient evidence to support a citation for supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))
